notes.title: VASARA Collection is OUT NOW on #Steam for $5.99 (40% launch discount)
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

We're extremely happy to announce that [i][b]VASARA Collection[/b][/i] is now available on Steam with a [b]40%[/b] launch discount, but hurry up, this offer ends August 20!

Console versions also coming out this month; PS4, PSVita, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch.

Thank you all for your patience!
